import sys

def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    N = int(lines[0])
    A = list(map(int, lines[1].split()))
    X = int(lines[2])

    total_deficit = sum(max(0, -ai) for ai in A)
    cost_type2 = total_deficit

    if X == 0:
        print(cost_type2)
        return
